name: unknown-root-key
why: A key a newer build added must survive an older build opening and saving the project, or a staggered rollout silently strips data — the property the whole additive-schema approach rests on.
divergence: macOS carries unknown root keys in its `extra` bag and re-encodes them. Windows' coerceManifest rebuilds the manifest field by field, so anything it does not name is dropped on every read.
